featured_reviews.name: Bekxy Kuriakose
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am a resident in Kukreja Residency for last 10 years. I bought a flat in 2009 in A wing. There are 3 wings A, B (least preferred because its sandwiched between A and C and lobby is smallest) and C wing. When we bought it had still many unoccupied flats and was a cosmopolitan Society with educated corporate type of residents. Finally residents got together and Housing Society was formed in February 2017 when builder kept procrastinating and was charging exhorbitantly high transfer fees. However the peace and unity of this lovely society I call home got disturbed due to the entry of some unscrupulous residents who became troublemakers.

As a result conditions have deteriorated sharply in the Society. An administrator has taken over the affairs of the society. There is no Managing Committee. Various residents have filed legal cases against each other and everyone is disllusioned. Many want to leave.

The swimming pool lies in a very poor condition and is not maintained. So also the small gym where most equipment is broken.

The building is more than 13 years old and badly in need of fresh coat of paint which is for all to see. Major waterproofing work needs to be done. As a result many of the upper floors are facing leakage issues in the monsoons or due to cracks and open terraces.

Once upon a time there was ample parking. However as more flats got sold and parking space got over (since builder had not planned parking for all flats), many haphazard areas started being allocated to parking. So its become congested. Once upon a time I used to love taking walks, now I am afraid to walk as cars may come from any direction.

There is no play area for children, hence they are at risk too in the evenings when cars.come in although speed limits are specified (many dont follow)

Residents have dumped debris.on staircases in many floors leading to fire safety hazards as also constructed illegal box grills.

The.only saving grace is the location. There is security team who are doing a decent jib as well as cctv cameras. Clubhouse is one of the amenities which is in decent condition. The current manager and his staff are.competent and doing a decent job inspite.of the fact that there.is no.managing committee.

However major decisions are.pending. Society is yet to get conveyance. Painting, Maintenance, waterproofing all are long due.

Everyone is waiting for elections but noone has any idea when it will happen.

Also to add I saw.many of the favourable reviews and was surprised. Then I saw that mostly none of them are actual residents! Perhaps they are brokers affiliated to the Builder so beware and do your own thorough research.

Oct 2024 Update:
I still live in Kukreja Residency and am happy to let you know things have turned for the better. Since July 2022, elections were held and there is a proper managing committee in place. I am the Treasurer. We have cleaned up a lot of the mess left behind by administrators. Lobby, clubhouse and gym have been renovated and look super now.
We are now planning major repairs and painting and waterproofing . yes some issues remain including swimming pool, no play area, etc. But we hope to tackle everything one by one. Many leakage complaints have been sorted out methodically though some are still there mainly due to internal flat member issues. Society is now compliant in most aspects be it fire safety, backup DG set, lift maintenance, housekeeping, and a better security agency has been put in place. Other maintenance works happen on time like storm water drain and underground cleaning, tree trimming, conducting education and training as per byelaws for members, conducting agbms and sgbms and audits approved for all financial years.

We are becoming better and meanwhile the location aspect has just improved even more with more highways and freeways to all over and outside Mumbai

featured_reviews.name: vedant gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
The builder is really pathetic. He has not thought of the HUGE parking problem that this society faces. Multiple issues :

- There are MORE flats than there are parkings. As a result there is fight for getting a parking for you 4-wheeler.

- There is a PUZZLE Parking. So you have to wait for almost 10-15 minutes at times to remove/park your car. On top of that, the puzzle parking fails to work many times and also adds to the huge maintenance costs of this society.

- There is NO PROVISION for parking of two wheelers. As a result, the 2 wheelers are parked in a place where there is an issue to fire safety norms.

- The building is constructed in such a way, that cars FAIL to go around the building to use the parking spots on the backside. As a result while there is less parking, more than half of those slots remain unaccessible due to the HUGE BLUNDER made by the builder.

- The management committee and the builder are in CONFLICT over a number of issues.

- Despite all the above challenges, the builder CONTINUES to sell parking spots. That's the degree to which you will be cheated, because you will pay for parking but then the management committee shall not allow you to park your vehicle.

- The builder and posters and propaganda will talk about the swimming pool, but the truth is, that the swimming pool has been DEFUNCT and will continue to be so in the near future.

- There is a HIGH maintenance cost to this society. The reasons are : Puzzle parking costs, high number of security personnel needed since there is no one-single-gate, defunct rooftop amenities needed, regular and frequent costs related to lifts, etc.

VERDICT :
Do not purchase a flat here if you will own a vehicle in the future.
Do not purchase a flat here if you are hoping of a dream home.
Do not purchase a flat here hoping for lavish amenities.

ONLY Purchase a flat here, if you will never own any vehicle, and don't mind paying a little extra in maintenance for features that you won't even use.

The ONLY good thing about buying a home here, is the LOCATION and the BUILD QUALITY.
